gloss: on the occasion of; at the time of

definitions.gloss: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
definitions.explanation: Formal expression used when something important or special happens.

examples.japanese: ご{結婚|けっこん}に{際|さい}して、お{祝|いわ}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: On the occasion of your marriage, I offer my congratulations.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}に{際|さい}して、{以下|いか}の{点|てん}にご{注意|ちゅうい}ください。
examples.english: At the time of the contract, please note the following points.

examples.japanese: {開会|かいかい}に{際|さい}して、{社長|しゃちょう}より{挨拶|あいさつ}がございます。
examples.english: On this opening occasion, there will be a greeting from the company president.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
Noun + に{際|さい}して
Verb (dictionary form) + に{際|さい}して

VARIATIONS:
・に{際|さい}して (adverbial)
・に{際|さい}しての + Noun (adnominal: に{際|さい}しての{注意事項|ちゅういじこう})
・に{際|さい}し (abbreviated form in very formal writing)

REGISTER:
Very formal. Used in ceremonies, official documents, speeches, and business correspondence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{入学|にゅうがく}に{際|さい}して (on entering school)
・{開業|かいぎょう}に{際|さい}して (on opening a business)
・{退職|たいしょく}に{際|さい}して (on retirement)
